topic: Connecting multiple datasets to campaign planner
summary_markdown: The discussion focused on the technical feasibility of connecting and viewing results from different datasets within a campaign planning tool. It was confirmed that this functionality can be implemented, specifically via a URL parameter, allowing users to select various datasets (similar to how it works in a traffic dashboard). The deployment target for this feature is set for the beta environment.
decisions: The ability to connect and view results from multiple datasets in the campaign planner will be implemented via a URL.
